content:
Apple TV and Apple Music for Android have rolled out major updates today, both centered on home screen widgets.

Apple TV 2.5 introduces three widgets that can bring the "Continue Watching" carousel from the top of the main tab to the home screen. The small Apple TV widget shows just one episode or one movie, while the medium size displays double the content.

The large Apple TV widget showcases the first item with bigger artwork, accompanied by a scrollable list for easy browsing — tap to play instantly.

These widgets cannot be resized, matching those available on iOS. Apple TV version 2.5 begins rolling out via the Play Store starting today.

Meanwhile, Apple Music 6.5 is also rolling out widely today. Compared to the previous 5.2 version, the version number has jumped significantly — likely because Apple is aligning its version numbering with iOS (the current stable release for iPhone is 26.5).

This update adds two brand-new widgets. "Pins" allows "quick access to your pinned items," while "Live Radio" lets you start playback without entering its dedicated tab. Together with the existing "Now Playing," "Recently Played," "Recommendations" and "Top Charts," the selection is now even richer.

Another update today is the ability to "share songs, albums, playlists and lyrics to WhatsApp."
